messages:
Ava: quick check — compact mode on iPhone SE: action buttons (Run / Edit) get clipped and table rows wrap badly when long job names appear. Screenshot: https://img.internal/mock1.png
Sam: saw it. repro on dev build. .action-bar is flex + gap; at small widths labels overflow.
Riley: do we want to hide secondary actions or iconify them? both have tradeoffs for discoverability.
Jin: overflow menu is safest for discoverability + keyboard focus. but if we iconify, need aria-labels. touch target min should remain 44px.
Ava: I sketched two approaches:
- Option A: collapse secondary into a "More actions" overflow menu, keep primary as full-width pill on small screens.
- Option B: icon-only actions with visible labels exposed on long-press/tooltip.
Mock: https://figma.com/proto/compact-actions
Sam: quick CSS test: `@media (max-width: 360px) { .row .actions { gap: 8px; } }` — helps a bit but cells still squeeze and cause multi-line job names.
Sam: alternative: let the primary action float as a sticky footer for table detail views, or a floating primary button for lists.
Riley: sticky footer feels heavy for list pages. floating primary + overflow menu per-row seems reasonable.
Ava: one more issue: when sidebar is collapsed in compact mode, tapping the edge expands it accidentally — users report accidental opens while scrolling. We probably need a higher touch/snap threshold.
Jin: agreed. current threshold is 8px. bumping to 18px should reduce accidental expands. also add a small drag handle affordance so it's discoverable.
Ava: copy nits from a11y perspective: the overflow trigger should have accessible text instead of only `•••`, e.g., `More actions`.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: icon-only buttons require `aria-label`. Maintain hit target >= 44px, and ensure menu is reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and announced with role="menu" + aria-expanded state.
Jin: i'll prototype: per-row overflow + floating primary; increase sidebar threshold; preserve tab order: checkbox -> row link -> primary -> overflow. will add axe checks.
Sam: for table overflow, maybe truncate job name with mid-ellipsis instead of wrap? `text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;` keeps layout stable. but ensure full name accessible via tooltip or screenreader.
Riley: yes — mid-ellipsis would be ideal for long hashes/names. cc: copy change for tooltip: "Full name" -> show name on long press.
Ava: updated figma with mid-ellipsis + overflow menu + revised sidebar interaction. demo gif: https://img.internal/compact-demo.gif
Jin: PR opened -> #3428. includes CSS, small JS for sidebar threshold, and added e2e a11y test (axe). target: beta rollout next week.
Riley: nice! can product QA run mobile exploratory? @Sam can you drop build link?
Sam: build posted: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234 — test on iPhone SE (safari) and Android small widths.
Ava: thanks all :thumbsup: will merge design spec after PR lands.
Jin: merging after review, will watch for regressions in beta.
